scientific_integrity: Full stated LDP follows analytically from order-preserving logit dynamics, explicit Beta logit density, exponential equivalence, and contraction; checker is a finite consistency check only.
scientific_limitations: Random Beta-distributed initial condition only; updates are deterministic. Assumes 0<a<=4, 0<b<1 and fixed positive shape exponents p,q. No finite-time prefactor or folding-regime theorem. Related historical work not exhaustively indexed; no independent mathematical audit.
title: An exact two-sided large-deviation law for transient means in a globally attracting replicator map
